github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text: Use the conventional commit format: a lowercase type (feat, fix, refactor, style, docs, test, chore, build, ci or perf), a colon, a space, then a short past-tense summary with no full stop, for example "feat: added photo likes" or "fix: fixed the invoice total rounding". Keep the summary line under about 72 characters. Add a blank line and a body only when the change needs explaining.
